title.narrative: In the first half of 2025, UNICEF continued to consolidate access to quality education through construction and rehabilitation of over 250 schools benefiting more than 200,000 children?over half of them girls?across seventeen provinces, launched foundational early childhood development activities, and piloted a cost-effective, risk-informed modality for field-based internal monitoring, reinforcing its commitment to inclusive, safe, and sustainable learning opportunities in hard-to-reach areas.
